summary: Phase 1 premium Excel seeder feature: generalize hardcoded 2-premium-type importer to support all 7 active blok input_type premiums from premium_definitions.json. Build header-name-based column mapping engine, dry-run preview pipeline, template generator, API routes, and frontend seeder workflow page. Import writes to payroll_manual_adjustments via saveAdjustment() with existing UPSERT support.
approach: Phase 1 targets blok input_type premiums only (PREMI PRUNING, RAKING, KINERJA, INSENTIF PANEN, TBS, JAGA, BANTU BRONDOL). Build column mapping engine first (TASK-001), then dry-run preview (TASK-002), generalize import function with progress tracking (TASK-003), template generator (TASK-004, parallel after TASK-001), API routes (TASK-005, after TASK-003+004), and frontend seeder page (TASK-006). Engine design supports extension to exp/kendaraan/blok+exp/amount input_types in later phases.

design_decisions.decision: Header-name-based column mapping with alias registry per input_type
design_decisions.rationale: More flexible than positional; handles varying column orders across divisions. Row 1 always treated as header row.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Requires header row always present. Slightly more complex parsing but eliminates position-dependency bugs.
alternatives: Fixed positional columns per premium type

design_decisions.decision: Dry-run preview mandatory before commit (no direct import without preview)
design_decisions.rationale: Reduces risk of bad data; follows ptkpExcelDryRunService precedent. Operators see what will change before committing.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Adds one extra API round-trip. Acceptable latency for data safety.

design_decisions.decision: UPSERT via existing saveAdjustment() rather than DELETE-then-INSERT
design_decisions.rationale: saveAdjustment already implements UPSERT for payroll_manual_adjustments. Re-import-safe without destructive deletes.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Cannot detect deleted rows (rows present before but absent in new file). Acceptable for premium seeding where files are complete snapshots.

design_decisions.decision: Phase 1 scope: blok input_type only (7 types). Non-blok types deferred.
design_decisions.rationale: 10 of 22 definitions use blok. Most common and most requested. Establishes patterns for other input_types.
design_decisions.tradeoff: kendaraan, exp, amount types not covered until later phases.

design_decisions.decision: Per-sheet premium type designation (sheet name = premium definition name)
design_decisions.rationale: Clean separation. One workbook can carry multiple premium types. Easy to validate against premium_definitions.json.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Requires sheet naming convention. Misnamed sheet rejected early with clear error.

conventions: Singleton service pattern (private static instance + getInstance)
ElysiaJS route groups with t.Object() body validation
Dynamic import for services in API routes
shared_context.auth_strategy: Existing auth middleware (Bearer token) applied to route group
